item.title: Food Network star Chef Niema DiGrazia to appear in Baton Rouge
item.description: Join celebrity chef Niema DiGrazia for a special culinary event in Baton Rouge, featuring Afro-Fusion cuisine and a chance to dine with a Food Network winner.

item.title: Two dead, two hurt in three separate weekend shootings in Baton Rouge
item.description: Baton Rouge police are searching for suspects in three separate shootings that happened over the weekend, two of them deadly, leaving residents on edge.

item.title: Four people killed in two separate crashes on I-12 over the weekend, police say
item.description: Four people killed in two separate crashes on I-12 near Albany/Springfield exit over the weekend. Police investigating.

item.title: Recall of peanut butter products distributed in 40 states, including Louisiana, categorized as 'Class II' by the FDA
item.description: A recall concerning single-serve containers of peanut butter distributed to Louisiana has been categorized as a “Class II” recall by the FDA.

item.title: 2 killed, 3 injured in Rhode Island ice rink shooting
item.description: Three people are dead, including the suspect, and three others are in critical condition after a shooting at a Rhode Island ice skating rink Monday afternoon.

item.title: Gold for Elana! Meyers Taylor, 41, wins Olympic monobob title at Milan Cortina Games
item.description: Elana Meyers Taylor has won World Cups, won world championships, already was the oldest woman to win an Olympic bobsled medal, recruited dozens of people to the sport and twice pulled off comebacks after becoming a mother.

item.title: Student accused of threatening and wrestling teacher at Istrouma High School
item.description: A student at Istrouma High School was arrested after wrestling and threatening a teacher, BRPD said.

item.title: Louisiana lawmakers to consider bill related to inmates released from jail by mistake
item.description: A Louisiana bill proposes that notifications be issued after an inmate has been improperly released from a parish prison or jail.

item.title: 4 people accused of possessing contraband at Elayn Hunt Correctional Center arrested
item.description: Four people were arrested at Elayn Hunt Correctional Center in Louisiana over the weekend for allegedly possessing contraband, including a gun, marijuana, and illegal drugs.

item.title: Police seek work-release inmate who fled job site
item.description: The West Baton Rouge Sheriff's Office is searching for Dwayne Cedotal, a 41-year-old work-release inmate who walked off a job site in Baton Rouge, and anyone with information is urged to contact them.
